title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.8 ships Flint as a pinned alias and doubles concurrent MTP throughput
summary: Flint 40B-A2.5B now installs from a release with an alias pinned to the benchmarked checkpoint (rapid-mlx serve flint-40b-a2.5b-4bit). Concurrent MTP chats now decode together: 4 parallel Qwen3.8-27B requests went from 35 to 75 tok/s on a Mac.

appearances.title: Rapid-MLX 0.16.5 runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on Mac
appearances.summary: Rapid-MLX 0.16.5 serves a mixed-precision MLX build of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 that keeps the full 40 by 384 expert layout, with a reported KL divergence of 0.439 and about 20 tok/s on an M3 Ultra. The same release adds MiniCPM-V 4.7 and LFM2.5-24B-A2B; the DeepSeek alias is greedy and text-only, with no tool calling and an 8,192-token input cap.
